_comment: Source of truth for the feedback survey. scripts/create_survey.py builds the survey from this file via the Qualtrics API, writes qualtrics-map.json, and regenerates the table in questions.md. Each page is one Qualtrics block (= one survey page). 'field' is the name used in response files; null = never exported (email). 'show_if' must refer to a question on an earlier page.
name: readme-bot: README review feedback
intro: Thanks for testing the README review skill. Your answers (without your email) are shared with the skill's maintainers in a private repository, where a maintainer decides whether to use them. Please do not include confidential data, unpublished results, or names. Please answer yourself; do not let an AI assistant fill in the survey. An assistant may help you draft the text for Q10.

choices: Other chatbot with the prompt file

pages.text: How useful was the report? (1 = not useful, 5 = very useful)
Did the report flag anything that was not a real problem?
Did it miss a problem you know about?
Did the edited copy contain invented facts (versions, URLs, data sources, runtimes)?
Was the report the right length?
Which finding was not a real problem, and why?

Proposed changes to the skill. If you (or your AI assistant) analyzed why the review went wrong, paste the analysis and concrete changes here, e.g. "In references/style-guide.md, add: ...". Plain text; no code to run.
May we quote your answers, anonymized, in public (e.g. in a change to the skill)?
Email, if you want a reply (never published)
